5 Steps to Take to Repair Your Roof After a Storm

14 May 2024 Roof Repair

Why Roof Repair After Storm Are Crucial

After a storm, your roof may sustain significant damage that needs immediate attention. Timely roof repairs can prevent further damage to your home and ensure the safety and comfort of your family. Here are five essential steps to take to repair your roof after a storm.

Steps to Repair Your Roof After a Storm

1. Conduct a Preliminary Inspection

The first step is to assess the damage by conducting a preliminary inspection. Look for visible signs of damage such as missing shingles, broken tiles, and debris on the roof. Check the attic for leaks or water stains on the ceiling.

Schedule a professional roof inspection with In The Light Roofing for a comprehensive assessment. Learn more about roof inspections.

2. Document the Damage

Take detailed photographs and videos of the damage from multiple angles. This documentation will be crucial when filing an insurance claim. Make sure to capture both the exterior and interior damage, if any.

In The Light Roofing can assist with detailed documentation during their inspection.

3. Make Temporary Repairs

To prevent further damage, make temporary repairs to your roof. Use tarps or plywood to cover exposed areas and secure loose shingles or tiles. This step helps protect your home from additional water damage until permanent repairs can be made.

In The Light Roofing offers emergency roof repair services to protect your home from further damage.

4. Contact Your Insurance Company

Notify your insurance company about the storm damage as soon as possible. Provide them with the documentation you’ve gathered and any temporary repair receipts. An adjuster will be sent to assess the damage and determine the coverage.

In The Light Roofing can help you navigate the insurance claims process and ensure all necessary documentation is submitted.

5. Hire a Professional Roofing Contractor

For permanent repairs, hire a professional roofing contractor. A qualified contractor will have the expertise and tools to properly fix storm damage and restore your roof’s integrity.

In The Light Roofing provides expert roof repair services and roof replacement services to ensure your roof is restored to its original condition.

FAQs

How soon should I inspect my roof after a storm?

It’s recommended to inspect your roof as soon as it’s safe to do so, ideally within a day or two after the storm.

Can I perform roof repairs myself?

While minor temporary repairs can be done yourself, it’s best to hire a professional for permanent repairs to ensure the job is done safely and correctly.

What should I do if my insurance claim is denied?

If your claim is denied, review the reasons provided by the insurance company. You may be able to appeal the decision or negotiate a different settlement with the help of a professional roofing contractor.
